corp_lines: Unallocated corporate expense and corporate eliminations
seg.seg_note: Three segments: Communication Systems, Electronic Systems, Space and Intelligence Systems. One corporate line: "Unallocated corporate expense and corporate eliminations" (226), which includes 101 of Exelis intangible amortization, 47 of charges for the exit of a commercial line of business and other items, 12 deferred compensation adjustment and 5 Exelis facility consolidation. Pre-ASC 606 / pre-ASU 2017-07 basis (pension income still inside segment operating income). Segment orders / backlog: ES orders $3.1 billion; funded backlog ES $2.6bn, SIS $1.1bn (10-K).

ngaap.guidance: FY2019 (initial, on the ASC 606 basis): revenue $6.53 - 6.65 billion (up 6 - 8%); EPS from continuing operations $7.65 - $7.85; free cash flow >= $1 billion (operating cash flow > $1,170 million, capital expenditures about $170 million); tax rate about 17.0%.
ngaap.notes: adj_ebit here is the "Non-GAAP operating income" of the FY2018 release (GAAP operating income 1,122 + 64 = 1,186; 19.2% margin) - before the FY2019 change to "adjusted EBIT", which also adds back non-operating pension income. Non-GAAP EPS excludes debt refinancing losses, the commercial line-of-business exit, the deferred compensation adjustment, Exelis charges, the tax on those and the non-cash tax-reform adjustment (+0.01). $ amounts: 47 / 12 / 5 from the 10-K segment note and the FY2019 release; 27 debt refinancing from the 10-K (the FY2019 release adjusted-EBIT table shows 26). Amortization of Exelis intangibles is NOT excluded. Adjusted free cash flow = operating cash flow + $300m voluntary pension contribution - capital expenditures.

notes: is.lines_raw = 10-K statement of income (first column) followed by the earnings-release condensed statement lines (prefixed "[Q4 release ...]"), which add dividends per share and weighted average shares; mapped keys use the 10-K. bs.tl is computed (total current liabilities + total non-current liabilities); not printed. cf.pension_contrib and cf.pension_income are as presented in the cash flow statement (pension income is a negative non-cash adjustment). is.nci is signed as a deduction (negative = loss attributable to noncontrolling interests added back). bs.st_debt = Short-term debt + Current portion of long-term debt (sum). cf.da = sum of the depreciation / amortization lines where split. cf.divest = sum of the proceeds-from-sale lines (businesses, discontinued operations, asset group, adjustments). Release Table 8 (preliminary ASC 606 recast of FY2018 / FY2017 by quarter and segment) is supplemental and not used for the main keys. seg_op_total_pub 1,348 is the "as reported" segment operating income total printed in release Table 8.
